mapper.select: /* ConcertMapper.selectConcertInfosByMonth 월별 콘서트 정보 조회 */ SELECT A.CONCERT_NO , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR , A.CONCERT_YEAR , A.CONCERT_MONTH , A.CONCERT_DATE , A.CONCERT_TIME , A.VENUE , A.TCT_SITE , A.TCT_OPEN_AT , A.POP_SCORE , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR , B.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl , A.SEND_YN FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT M1.ARTIST_NM_KOR , M1.CONCERT_YEAR , M1.CONCERT_MONTH , M1.CONCERT_DATE , M1.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL , MAX(M1.REG_TIME) AS REG_TIME FROM TB_ARTIST_MSG AS M1 GROUP BY M1.ARTIST_NM_KOR , M1.CONCERT_YEAR , M1.CONCERT_MONTH , M1.CONCERT_DATE , M1.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL ) AS B ON A.ARTIST_NM_KOR = B.ARTIST_NM_KOR AND A.CONCERT_YEAR = B.CONCERT_YEAR AND A.CONCERT_MONTH = B.CONCERT_MONTH AND A.CONCERT_DATE = B.CONCERT_DATE WHERE A.CONCERT_YEAR = #{year} AND A.CONCERT_MONTH = #{month} AND (A.CONCERT_DATE IS NULL OR A.CONCERT_DATE <> '0') GROUP BY A.CONCERT_YEAR , A.CONCERT_MONTH , A.CONCERT_DATE , A.VENUE ORDER BY A.CONCERT_DATE, A.POP_SCORE DESC

/* ConcertMapper.selectTodayFeatureConcert 오늘의 추천 공연 조회 */ SELECT A.CONCERT_NO , A.ARTIST_NM_KOR , A.ARTIST_NM_FOR , A.CONCERT_YEAR , A.CONCERT_MONTH , A.CONCERT_DATE , A.CONCERT_TIME , A.VENUE , A.TCT_SITE , A.TCT_OPEN_AT , B.SUBJECT , B.CONTENT , B.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL AS artistImageUrl , A.POP_SCORE , A.SEND_YN FROM TB_CONCERT_INFO AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT M1.ARTIST_NM_KOR , M1.CONCERT_YEAR , M1.CONCERT_MONTH , M1.CONCERT_DATE , M1.SUBJECT , M1.CONTENT , M1.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL , MAX(M1.REG_TIME) AS REG_TIME FROM TB_ARTIST_MSG AS M1 GROUP BY M1.ARTIST_NM_KOR , M1.CONCERT_YEAR , M1.CONCERT_MONTH , M1.CONCERT_DATE , M1.SUBJECT , M1.CONTENT , M1.ARTIST_IMAGE_URL ) AS B ON A.ARTIST_NM_KOR = B.ARTIST_NM_KOR AND A.CONCERT_YEAR = B.CONCERT_YEAR AND A.CONCERT_MONTH = B.CONCERT_MONTH AND A.CONCERT_DATE = B.CONCERT_DATE WHERE STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(A.CONCERT_YEAR, '-', LPAD(A.CONCERT_MONTH, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(A.CONCERT_DATE, 2, '0')), '%Y-%m-%d') >= CURDATE() AND (A.CONCERT_DATE IS NULL OR A.CONCERT_DATE <> '0') ORDER BY B.REG_TIME DESC LIMIT 1
